label: Ubiquiti UFiber Loco
description: GPON ONT: one SC/APC GPON WAN port and one gigabit RJ45 LAN port, powered by micro-USB or 24V passive PoE.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking interface **(1) SC/APC ITU-G.984 GPON WAN port and (1) GbE RJ45 LAN port**, power method **micro-USB 5V 1A or 24V passive PoE (pins 4,5+ / 7,8-)**, micro-USB adapter included **only in the single-pack**. Two practical notes: the PoE-in is **passive 24V**, so an 802.3af switch port will not power it, and the multi-pack SKUs ship **without** the USB adapter.
